requirements.quote: QCLASS fields appear in the question section of a query.
requirements.condition: When encoding or parsing a query.
requirements.required_behavior: Place and interpret QCLASS fields in the question section of the query.
requirements.why_checkable: The query encoder and parser identify which section contains each QCLASS field.

requirements.quote:
QCLASS values
are a superset of CLASS values; every CLASS is a valid QCLASS.
requirements.condition: When determining whether a QCLASS value is valid.
requirements.required_behavior: Treat every valid CLASS value as a valid QCLASS value.
requirements.why_checkable: The set of values accepted as QCLASS can be compared against the valid CLASS values.

requirements.quote:
In
addition to CLASS values, the following QCLASSes are defined:

*               255 any class
requirements.condition: When encoding or interpreting the any-class QCLASS (*).
requirements.required_behavior: Use QCLASS value 255 to denote any class.
requirements.why_checkable: The QCLASS encoding and decoding mapping for the any-class selector can be checked against numeric value 255.
